name: gitlab-mcp-server
description: GitLab MCP server exposing up to 1065 self-managed GitLab REST/GraphQL MCP tools, or 1071 on GitLab.com Ultimate with Orbit. Includes a default 2-tool dynamic surface, 32 base / 49 self-managed enterprise / 50 GitLab.com Enterprise meta-tools, 45 resources, 37 prompts, 17 completion types, and 4 MCP capabilities (completions, progress, elicitation, resource subscriptions).
